instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand resting over the shoulders, palms facing forward and elbows pointing down.
2. Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
3. Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat, pushing your knees slightly outward.
4. Descend until your thighs pass parallel to the floor.
5. Drive through your heels to extend your hips and knees back to standing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright; the front load helps you stay vertical.
2. Keep your elbows high so the dumbbells stay locked on your shoulders.
3. Track your knees over your toes and do not let them cave inward.
4. Breathe in as you descend and out as you stand.

instructions:
1. Start in a full planche with hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart and your body held parallel to the floor by your arms.
2. Extend your legs straight behind you and engage your core and glutes to hold a straight line.
3. Bend your elbows to lower your body toward the floor, keeping it horizontal.
4. Push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the planche.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your core and glutes to keep your body from sagging.
2. Protract your shoulders to keep the planche stable.
3. Use a firm, non-slip surface to protect your wrists.
4. Build the strength to hold a planche before adding the push-up.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to your chest with both hands on the handle.
2. Brace your core and keep your chest up.
3. Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat.
4. Descend until your thighs reach parallel to the floor.
5. Drive through your heels to extend your hips and knees back to standing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the kettlebell pulled in close to your chest throughout.
2. Track your knees over your toes and do not let them cave inward.
3. Keep your torso upright and brace your core against the front load.
4. Breathe in as you lower and out as you stand.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, the resistance band under both feet.
2. Hold a handle in each hand and place them against your shoulders.
3. Keep a slight bend in your knees and your back flat.
4. Hinge at your hips to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the floor.
5. Drive your hips forward to raise your torso back to standing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Hinge at the hips, not the waist, and keep your spine neutral.
2. Keep a soft bend in your knees throughout.
3. Squeeze your glutes to finish each rep.
4. Exhale as you rise and inhale as you hinge.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a barbell resting across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Keep a slight bend in your knees and your back flat.
3. Push your hips back and hinge forward to lower your torso toward the floor.
4. Stop when your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
5. Drive your hips forward to raise your torso back to standing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Hinge at the hips, not the waist, and keep your spine neutral.
2. Keep a soft bend in your knees to protect your lower back.
3. Brace your core hard before each rep.
4. Exhale as you rise and inhale as you hinge.
